purpose: Define bounded semantic translation interfaces for unresolved Russian game descriptions while preserving GitHub control-plane ownership across the existing scheduled worker and the explicitly user-launched one-shot manual semantic-worker mode.

owns: derive the exact current unresolved description scope
select the exact source text and source state for each request
construct and order the immutable translation work input
track unresolved state, retries, checkpoints, and completeness
validate returned keys, hashes, statuses, and Russian text quality
merge validated results into the canonical translation cache
invalidate stale cache entries when the source-text binding changes
rebuild downstream visual artifacts and publish explicit Russian-description diagnostics/observability
classify exact-bound per-item translation quality failures into translation diagnostics
persist and resolve the canonical translation diagnostic state

allowed: read only the exact immutable translation work input prepared by GitHub
translate non-Russian source text into meaningful Russian
rewrite weak Russian source text into meaningful Russian without changing material meaning
return only result records bound to exact request identities supplied by GitHub
forbidden: write directly to the canonical translation cache
create a separate recurring scheduler or daily quota
translate, retry, or resolve requests that GitHub has removed from the normal queue into translation diagnostics

manual_one_shot_chatgpt_data_plane.role: constrained semantic translation worker launched explicitly by the user
allowed: read only the exact current immutable translation work input prepared by GitHub
translate non-Russian source text into meaningful Russian
rewrite weak Russian source text into meaningful Russian without changing material meaning
return only result records bound to exact request identities supplied by GitHub
submit a strict subset checkpoint through the existing translation inbox when context durability requires it
submit a zero-result no-work receipt only when the current canonical queue is empty
forbidden: change source selection or canonical request order
write directly to the canonical translation cache
create or modify any Scheduled Task or recurring scheduler
continue after an accepted checkpoint without rereading the current GitHub-owned queue and bindings
translate or retry requests that GitHub has removed from the normal queue into translation diagnostics

runtime_reuse.rule: Translation may use a translation-specific queue/result schema, but GitHub must attach that work to the same GitHub-owned nightly production cycle and existing scheduled ChatGPT data-plane rather than creating an independent chat-owned scheduler.
runtime_reuse.manual_worker_rule: Every run requires a fresh explicit user launch. The one-shot chat is a semantic data-plane exception only; ordinary interactive developer/operator chats remain non-production.

scope.rule: The work input contains the full current set of description records that remain unresolved after deterministic Russian-source resolution and are semantically translatable. Technical/missing-source cases remain explicit GitHub-owned data-quality blockers and must not be disguised as translation requests.

reserved_artifacts_for_followup_implemen.note: These are the canonical implemented translation artifacts. Semantic workers write only result transport; GitHub validates/persists cache and current status.

request_identity.request_id_serialization: UTF-8 strings joined by LF with no trailing LF
request_identity.freshness_rule: A translation is reusable only for the exact source_key and source_text_sha256/source_version binding. Any normalized source-text change creates a different request identity and re-enters GitHub-owned unresolved scope if still needed.

field_rules.request_id: 64 lowercase hexadecimal sha256 computed by request_identity
field_rules.source_appid: decimal Steam appid encoded as string
field_rules.title: nonempty display title used only to improve translation quality; not identity
field_rules.source_text: nonempty normalized exact source text selected by GitHub
field_rules.source_text_sha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal sha256 of normalized source_text UTF-8 bytes
field_rules.source_path: nonempty repository/API provenance label chosen by GitHub

request_schema.context_minimization_rule: Do not include price, discount, history, reviews, wishlist, Taste verdicts, ranking, purchase context, or unrelated production fields.

worker_output_binding.subset_checkpoint_rule: A submission may contain a strict subset of current requests for transport/checkpoint reasons. Missing results remain unresolved; subset size never becomes a daily quota or completeness rule.
worker_output_binding.zero_result_submission_rule: A zero-result submission is a successful no-work check only when the exact current canonical queue is empty. With a nonempty queue it is not an attempted translation and does not advance attempt/success observability.

github_validation.placeholder_or_technical_text_action: do_not_cache; quarantine exact current request in translation diagnostics; continue validating safe siblings
github_validation.non_ru_or_weak_ru_result_action: do_not_cache; quarantine exact current request in translation diagnostics; continue validating safe siblings
github_validation.worker_error_action: do_not_cache; GitHub keeps request unresolved and applies GitHub-owned retry policy
github_validation.submission_level_failure_rule: Malformed container/top-level schema, duplicate request identity, unknown/stale request identity, exact binding mismatch, invalid status, or unsafe cross-field contract corruption rejects the submission before any sibling persistence.
github_validation.item_level_quality_failure_rule: After exact current identity and record contract checks succeed, a translated result that does not classify as good_ru is isolated to GitHub-owned translation diagnostics; valid sibling results remain acceptable.

persistence_and_invalidation.current_direct_ready_ru_precedence: A current deterministic ready_ru source remains authoritative; translation cache is only a reusable resolution for otherwise unresolved translatable source text.

retry_and_completeness.success_condition: Normal translation semantic work is complete when the current normal translation queue is empty. Current exact-bound quality failures may remain separately unresolved in translation diagnostics, while technical/missing-source blockers remain explicit; neither diagnostic nor nontranslatable blockers silently become ready_ru.
retry_and_completeness.stale_or_invalid_result: Submission/container or identity corruption remains fail-closed and does not create a diagnostic. An exact-bound translated result that fails good_ru enters diagnostics and is removed from the normal retry queue.

downstream.publication_policy: Missing/unresolved Russian descriptions are a GitHub-owned nonblocking publication diagnostic. Translation acceptance itself remains fail-closed: non-Russian/weak text, wrong AppID, stale binding, invalid provenance or invalid result transport never becomes ready_ru.

fields.untranslated_game_count: Current number of scope records whose description is not resolved to exact valid ready_ru.
fields.last_translation_attempt_at_utc: Advances when the current prepared translation work is actually checked/attempted: an exact-bound result submission is ingested, including a valid worker error, or the GitHub translation-scope check finds queue_count=0.
fields.last_successful_translation_at_utc: Advances when at least one exact-bound good_ru translation is accepted/persisted, or when the GitHub translation-scope check finds queue_count=0.
fields.translation_diagnostic_count: Current number of unresolved translatable requests suppressed from the normal translation queue by an active exact-binding translation diagnostic.

observability.partial_success_rule: If one or more exact-bound translations are accepted, last_successful_translation_at_utc advances even when sibling exact-bound quality failures enter diagnostics or other unresolved current items remain; queue_count, translation_diagnostic_count and untranslated_game_count are rebuilt honestly from the current scope.
observability.failed_attempt_rule: A current exact-bound valid error result advances last_translation_attempt_at_utc but not last_successful_translation_at_utc.
observability.invalid_or_stale_transport_rule: A structurally invalid, stale, wrong-AppID or wrong-binding submission is rejected fail-closed and is not recorded as a successful/current-work translation attempt.
observability.zero_work_rule: A current translation-scope check with queue_count=0 is both an attempt/check and a successful no-work outcome. An explicitly launched manual semantic worker records this only through a zero-result canonical submission ingested while the current queue is empty; the worker never supplies its own timestamp.
observability.browser_rule: The browser may format producer-owned untranslated_game_count, translation_diagnostic_count and timestamps only; it must not infer them from cards, queue files, client state, page load, deploy time, commit time or payload age.

diagnostic_quarantine.trigger: Only an exact-current, exact-bound status=translated result whose translated_text_ru fails the canonical good_ru quality gate after container/identity validation.
diagnostic_quarantine.normal_queue_rule: An active diagnostic entry matching the exact current request identity is excluded from the normal translation semantic queue and cannot be automatically retried by normal translation workers.
diagnostic_quarantine.worker_role: Semantic workers neither choose diagnostic eligibility nor diagnose/resolve/retry diagnostic entries.
diagnostic_quarantine.source_change_rule: A changed normalized source text creates a new request_id; an active diagnostic for the old request_id does not suppress the new current request.
diagnostic_quarantine.direct_ready_ru_rule: If deterministic current source resolution becomes ready_ru, no translation request exists and the historical diagnostic is not counted as current work.
diagnostic_quarantine.explicit_resolution_rule: A GitHub-owned explicit resolution marks the exact diagnostic entry resolved; if the exact source remains unresolved/translatable, normal queue construction may then emit that exact request again.
diagnostic_quarantine.idempotency_rule: Diagnostic state is keyed by exact request_id, so re-ingest cannot create duplicate diagnostic entries.
